title: Venus pe Din, Saal Se Bhi Lamba!
idea: Venus spins so slowly (243 Earth days per rotation) that its day is longer than its 225-day year, and it spins backwards so the Sun rises in the west.

lines.text: Ek planet aisa hai jahan ek din, poore saal se bhi lamba hota hai!
Venus ko apni dhuri pe ek chakkar lagane mein 243 Earth din lagte hain.
Lekin Sooraj ka poora round woh sirf 225 din mein kar leta hai.
Wajah? Uski zameen sirf 6.5 km/h se ghoomti hai, bas tez walk jitna!
Aur hamari Earth? Equator pe lagbhag 1670 km/h, Mumbai local se kai guna tez!
Aur ulta ghoomne se wahan Sooraj west se ugta hai! Pehle pata tha?

facts.claim: A day (one rotation) on Venus lasts about 243 Earth days, and a year on Venus lasts about 225 Earth days.
Venus rotates retrograde (east to west), so the Sun would rise in the west and set in the east.
Venus's equatorial rotation speed is about 6.52 km/h (radius 6,051.8 km, rotation period 5,832.5 hours).
Earth's surface at the equator rotates at about 1,674 km/h (roughly 1,670 km/h).
